Torque in N·mm. Columns 10K–50K = allowable torque at given cycle life (% of Mmax): 100% / 92% / 87% / 83% / 72%. Mmax (10K) — FlexiForce spring tables, Black (galvanized springs are rated as Black); it is not recalculated.
